field_evidence_policy: The participant cannot conduct on-site fieldwork. Licensed public data may establish network, morphology, service and land-cover proxies, but it must not be represented as observed public life, perceived comfort, accessibility compliance or verified ground-floor activity. Those claims remain unknown until a local professional or cleared community partner completes the declared protocol.
authority_boundary: This file defines design methods, candidate indicators and data-collection protocols. It is not existing-conditions evidence, a statutory planning control, an engineering conclusion or an implementation approval.

key_area_label_policy.rule: The three AI-prefixed key-area names are retained because they are taskbook scope labels. The label does not make every spatial role, public-space move or renewal project an AI installation.

areas.ai_role: Optional testing, standards and release services after public access and environmental conditions pass review

areas.primary_spatial_role: Four-quadrant station access, active service frontages, planned-green-space coordination and incremental renewal

mapping_semantics.provisional_key_area_extent: Neutral dashed search extent derived from taskbook order and approximate area; not a parcel, road redline, ownership boundary or functional zone.
mapping_semantics.land_use_scaffold: The four full-length polygons in land_use.geojson are a closed-topology design scaffold used for formal package recalculation. Figure 02 reports their conceptual supply shares but does not paint them as existing or parcel-level land use.
mapping_semantics.osm_context: ODbL-attributed streets and building footprints are rendered as low-contrast morphology context. M/A/P concept fields follow this texture for visual discussion only and are not submitted planning geometry or metric evidence.

cross_cutting_lenses.railway_heritage: Historical and spatial thread across all three focus areas.
cross_cutting_lenses.open_innovation: Release, learning, testing and collaboration mechanism that may operate in different spatial carriers.
cross_cutting_lenses.public_life: Everyday network of ground-floor edges, walking, staying and civic services.
cross_cutting_lenses.ai: Optional service layer admitted only after spatial, access, human-fallback and governance conditions pass review.

tests.question: Do different primary uses meet at a publicly accessible edge, with small reversible improvements before heavy construction?
tests.minimum_rule: Do not assign retain, renovate or demolish status or run enterprise-only public space without an evidence-backed inventory.

tests.question: Are walking, cycling, station access and public transport continuous before a smart-mobility interface is added?
tests.minimum_rule: Do not claim a continuous corridor or release an AI route without a verified network and accessible fallback.

tests.label_zh: 可停留、可观察、可调整的公共生活
tests.question: Can people arrive, stay, choose activities and use a non-digital service fallback, with observations feeding design adjustment?
tests.minimum_rule: Do not claim existing vitality, safety or comfort before an independent local observation.

design_thesis.ai_release_rule: A civic AI scenario proceeds only after the three spatial tests each have a declared baseline, method, limitation, minimum-data rule, human fallback, pause condition, steward function and public-return measure.

theory_translation.limitation: Project indicators are operational proxies derived from the cited method, not universal thresholds or Beijing statutory standards.
Network bands are analysis parameters; local mode share, service, parking and energy claims require official or cleared Beijing data.
The quality criteria are an observation framework, not statutory numerical requirements.

moves: Mix research, public release, daily services and small collaboration spaces at publicly accessible edges.
Audit the Qinghe and campus edges for entrances, barriers, shade, seating and staying activity.
Verify walking, cycling and public-transport access across major road barriers before claiming connectivity.
Create fine-grained campus-park-neighborhood links and time-complementary learning, release and daily-service uses.
Prioritize continuous accessible routes, active ground-floor edges and small public learning nodes.
Measure last-mile detour between campuses, neighborhoods, workplaces and station entrances.
Mix station-area commerce, work, exchange, resident services and evening civic services.
Use the four station quadrants as public-life observation units for crossings, edges, seating, shade and night use.
Model station entrances, road barriers, bus interchange and cycle parking in one pedestrian network.

scenario_release_protocol.steward_boundary: Steward functions are design requirements, not confirmed appointments. Named operators, budgets and legal responsibilities require later agreement.

scenario_cards.name: open_source_release_hall
scenario_cards.minimum_evidence: Authorized event schedule, step-free route audit, aggregate attendance and day-evening use baseline.
scenario_cards.human_fallback: Staffed registration, information and presentation support without mandatory app or facial recognition.
scenario_cards.pause_trigger: Pause public trials when access, crowding, safety review, content rights or manual service cannot be maintained.

scenario_cards.name: safety_governance_sandbox
scenario_cards.minimum_evidence: Declared test purpose, authorized test data, risk classification, audit log and affected-user notice.
scenario_cards.human_fallback: Qualified reviewer controls admission, interpretation and incident response.
scenario_cards.pause_trigger: Stop on scope drift, unapproved data, unresolved harmful output, failed audit logging or complaint escalation.

scenario_cards.name: edge_compute_service_point
scenario_cards.minimum_evidence: Energy capacity, heat and noise review, accessible service route, data inventory and maintenance plan.
scenario_cards.human_fallback: In-person or telephone service channel for essential public services.
scenario_cards.pause_trigger: Stop public service when security, energy, thermal, noise, accessibility or maintenance limits are exceeded.

scenario_cards.name: ai_assisted_slow_mobility_navigation
scenario_cards.minimum_evidence: Verified walk-cycle graph, crossings, barriers, step-free routes and time-stamped aggregate counts.
scenario_cards.human_fallback: Static high-contrast and tactile wayfinding plus staffed assistance at key events.
scenario_cards.pause_trigger: Withdraw routing when closures, accessibility status, positioning accuracy or emergency detours are stale or unsafe.

scenario_cards.name: dazhongsi_international_demo_living_room
scenario_cards.minimum_evidence: Station access, event timetable, public-private space boundary, rights clearance and day-evening public-life baseline.
scenario_cards.human_fallback: On-site multilingual reception and non-digital booking channel.
scenario_cards.pause_trigger: Pause events when station access, crowd management, licensing, local disturbance or public access conditions fail.

scenario_cards.name: qinghe_low_car_innovation_edge
scenario_cards.minimum_evidence: Flood and ecological controls, path continuity, entrances, shade, seating, cycle access and staying observations.
scenario_cards.human_fallback: Conventional environmental signage, maintenance contact and accessible detour.
scenario_cards.pause_trigger: Close affected segments for flood, ecological, heat, maintenance or accessibility hazards.

scenario_cards.name: campus_neighborhood_transfer_street
scenario_cards.minimum_evidence: Ground-floor uses, rents or affordability proxies, opening hours, entrances, walking barriers and authorized service demand.
scenario_cards.human_fallback: Walk-in legal, intellectual-property and enterprise-service desk.
scenario_cards.pause_trigger: Suspend a digital service on exclusion, misleading advice, inaccessible access, unlicensed data or unresolved conflicts of interest.

scenario_cards.name: data_governance_meeting_room
scenario_cards.minimum_evidence: Dataset provenance, legal basis, permission scope, retention, audit and public explanation for every demonstration.
scenario_cards.human_fallback: Qualified staff explain decisions and accept correction or complaint requests.
scenario_cards.pause_trigger: Stop on uncertain provenance, excessive collection, re-identification risk, failed deletion or misleading claims.

scenario_cards.name: inclusive_ai_daily_service_street
scenario_cards.minimum_evidence: Resident needs, existing services, opening hours, accessible routes, non-digital demand and sector-specific authorization.
scenario_cards.human_fallback: Parallel staffed service for medical, education, legal and daily-life requests where applicable.
scenario_cards.pause_trigger: Stop a service on discriminatory outcome, unsafe advice, unavailable human escalation, privacy breach or displacement of essential access.

scenario_cards.name: global_ai_public_life_route
scenario_cards.minimum_evidence: Continuous verified route, venue permissions, heritage controls, accessible alternatives, transit plan and event capacity.
scenario_cards.human_fallback: Printed and tactile route information, staffed checkpoints and non-digital participation.
scenario_cards.pause_trigger: Shorten or cancel the route when continuity, heritage protection, weather, crowding, local disturbance or accessibility cannot be assured.

remote_open_data_protocol.metric_status_rule: A metric may become known only when the downloaded artifact, license, raw SHA-256, query, CRS, clipping method, completeness limitation and calculation are recorded. Observed public-life metrics remain unknown without a time-stamped local survey.
remote_open_data_protocol.future_local_validation: A local planning professional, university studio or cleared community partner may execute the field protocol later. Their aggregate observations must be separately attributed and must not contain names, faces, device identifiers or individual trajectories.

open_data_candidates.formal_boundary: Background and reproducible proxy analysis only; never an official boundary, road redline, ownership or statutory control.

retrieval_record.integration_policy: Do not replace submitted conceptual geometry or publish raw-derived target values until relation/way duplication, feature completeness, a second source cross-check and professional review are complete.

open_data_candidates.formal_boundary: Use only if the generated extract preserves OSM attribution and query extent metadata.

preferred_formats: GeoJSON or Shapefile when explicitly offered
open_data_candidates.formal_boundary: Public reachability alone does not establish redistribution rights or formal planning authority.

open_data_candidates.formal_boundary: Land-cover cross-check only; not a green-line, flood-line or heritage-control source.

field_protocol.privacy: Record aggregate categories only. Do not collect names, faces, device identifiers or individual trajectories.

processing_workflow: Use provisional geometry only as a discovery extent, never as an official control.
Keep large raw downloads in a Git-ignored research cache until rights and relevance are reviewed.
Record publisher, URL, publication and retrieval dates, license, coverage, CRS, raw hash, query and transformation.
Exchange spatial data in EPSG:4326 and calculate length and area in EPSG:4548.
Separate existing conditions, design proposals and official controls into explicit fields or layers.
Establish a baseline before selecting targets; prefer relative improvement and minimum usability where no local standard exists.
Cross-check material indicators with another credible source or independent calculation.
Record sources in sources.json, gaps in assumptions.json, metrics in metrics.json and spatial objects in GeoJSON.
When official geometry arrives, recompute geometry, metrics, figures, HTML and drawings together.
